text: Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a "No Stopping Anytime" regulation on the south side of Broadway Avenue, between a point 35 metres east of Yonge Street to a point 63 metres further east. The proposed changes will address residents' concerns with the obstructed flow of two-way traffic caused by illegal parking on Broadway Avenue, fronting the apartment buildings at 7, 9 and 11 Broadway Avenue. This report is submitted to Public Works and Infrastructure Committee as Broadway Avenue forms a shared boundary between the Toronto and East York Community Council and the North York Community Council.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit stopping at all times on the south side of Broadway Avenue, between a point 35 metres east of Yonge Street and a point 63 metres further east.
